title.div: Industrial product and raw materials price indexes, September 2026

summary.div: In September, the Industrial Product Price Index rose 2.0% month over month and increased 14.5% year over year. The Raw Materials Price Index rose 4.8% month over month in September and increased 27.0% year over year.

title.div: Travel between Canada and other countries, August 2026

summary.div: In August, the number of Canadian-resident return trips from the United States increased 9.3% year over year, while trips to Canada by US residents rose 4.3%.

Data tables for Employment Insurance (EI) statistics have been updated to August 2026. These revised tables are now available on the Statistics Canada website. Data on EI for September 2026 will be released on November 18.
The New Housing Price Index (December 2016=100) is now available for September.
Data for September on the production and inventories of refined petroleum products in Canada are now available upon request.
The total value of investment in building construction edged up $25.1 million (+0.1%) to $23.5 billion in August.

title.div: Impact of cybercrime on Canadian businesses, 2025

summary.div: Since 2017, the Canadian Survey of Cyber Security and Cybercrime has measured the evolution of the impact of cyber security on Canadian businesses. This includes the types of cyber security incidents that are impacting businesses, the prevention measures businesses are taking, and the repercussions of these incidents.

Public health recommendations, such as the one for adults to accumulate at least 150 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity per week, are useful for tracking population-level trends. However, knowing whether Canadians meet this threshold does not tell the whole story. Indeed, it is also important to know the proportion of adults who do not meet the recommendation but are close to reaching it, and the proportion of adults who are much further away from reaching it.
